name: Akutar NFT
fix_description: In claimProjectFunds, fix the require statement: change require(refundProgress >= totalBids) to require(refundProgress >= _bidIndex). The variable totalBids incorrectly counts total bid submissions (including multiple bids per user), while _bidIndex tracks unique bidders which is what refundProgress iterates over. This mismatch makes the condition permanently unsatisfiable, locking all funds.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC demonstrates two straightforward logic bugs with minimal setup: a refund DoS caused by sending ETH to a reverting contract and an obvious incorrect require condition that locks funds. The exploit uses simple direct calls on a fork with no flash loans, no complex DeFi primitives, and only basic time-warping to reach the vulnerable states.
